assumptions.content: Authorization scoping (HIPAA minimum necessary) is not enforced at application level - all authenticated clinicians can access all patients
No formal audit trail for clinical note modifications beyond CloudWatch logs
WebSocket connection flooding has limited mitigation beyond WAF rate limiting
AI-generated clinical notes may contain inaccuracies (hallucination risk) mitigated by human review but not eliminated

mitigations.content: Cognito User Pool with OAuth2 integration at ALB level. All requests authenticated before reaching application.
AWS WAF WebACL with rate limiting, IP allowlist, and managed rule groups attached to ALB.
TLS 1.2+ encryption on all connections. ALB terminates HTTPS, Aurora uses RDS CA bundle for TLS verification.
KMS encryption at rest for S3 output bucket, Aurora database, Secrets Manager secrets, and CloudWatch Logs.
Least-privilege IAM policies scoped to specific resource ARNs. No wildcard actions except where APIs require it.
Secrets Manager for all credentials with no plain-text environment variables. ECS references via secrets property.
Parameterized SQL queries for all database operations preventing SQL injection.
PHI-sanitized logging - only error names/types logged, never clinical content or patient data.
Private subnets with security groups restricting database access to ECS tasks only.
Human-in-the-loop validation for AI-generated clinical notes before EHR submission.
Amazon Bedrock Guardrails for content filtering on AI model invocations.
Pinned dependency versions in package.json and package-lock.json to prevent supply chain attacks.
CloudTrail and CloudWatch monitoring for security-relevant API calls and anomalous behavior.
S3 bucket policies blocking public access and restricting writes to Connect Health service principal only.

threats.prerequisites: with network access to the ALB endpoint
threats.threatAction: bypass Cognito authentication via token forgery or session hijacking
threats.threatImpact: unauthorized access to clinical data and patient PHI
threats.statement: A External attacker with network access to the ALB endpoint can bypass Cognito authentication via token forgery or session hijacking, which leads to unauthorized access to clinical data and patient PHI

threats.threatSource: Malicious insider or compromised clinician account
threats.threatAction: access patient records beyond their authorized scope
threats.threatImpact: unauthorized PHI disclosure violating HIPAA minimum necessary
threats.statement: A Malicious insider or compromised clinician account with valid Cognito credentials can access patient records beyond their authorized scope, which leads to unauthorized PHI disclosure violating HIPAA minimum necessary

threats.prerequisites: on path between browser and ALB
threats.threatAction: intercept audio stream or clinical note data in transit
threats.threatImpact: exposure of PHI from patient encounters
threats.statement: A Attacker with network position on path between browser and ALB can intercept audio stream or clinical note data in transit, which leads to exposure of PHI from patient encounters

threats.threatAction: modify clinical notes in Aurora after clinician approval
threats.threatImpact: integrity of medical record compromised, patient safety risk
threats.statement: A Privileged user or attacker with database access can modify clinical notes in Aurora after clinician approval, which leads to integrity of medical record compromised, patient safety risk

threats.prerequisites: who has compromised the ECS task or credentials
threats.threatAction: deny responsibility for clinical note modifications
threats.threatImpact: inability to audit who modified patient records
threats.statement: A Malicious actor who has compromised the ECS task or credentials can deny responsibility for clinical note modifications, which leads to inability to audit who modified patient records

threats.prerequisites: with access to S3 bucket or database
threats.threatAction: exfiltrate clinical transcripts and SOAP notes containing PHI
threats.threatImpact: large-scale PHI breach requiring HIPAA notification
threats.statement: A External attacker or insider with access to S3 bucket or database can exfiltrate clinical transcripts and SOAP notes containing PHI, which leads to large-scale PHI breach requiring HIPAA notification

threats.prerequisites: who gains access to CloudWatch Logs
threats.threatAction: extract PHI from application log entries
threats.statement: A Attacker who gains access to CloudWatch Logs can extract PHI from application log entries, which leads to PHI exposure through operational logs

threats.threatAction: launch DDoS or resource exhaustion against the application
threats.threatImpact: clinical workflow disruption during patient encounters
threats.statement: A External attacker with internet access to ALB can launch DDoS or resource exhaustion against the application, which leads to clinical workflow disruption during patient encounters

threats.threatAction: flood WebSocket connections exhausting ECS task resources
threats.threatImpact: active audio streaming sessions interrupted mid-encounter
threats.statement: A Automated scanner or attacker targeting exposed WebSocket endpoint can flood WebSocket connections exhausting ECS task resources, which leads to active audio streaming sessions interrupted mid-encounter

threats.threatAction: escalate privileges to access resources beyond intended scope
threats.threatImpact: unauthorized access to KMS keys, secrets, or other accounts
threats.statement: A Compromised or misconfigured IAM policy with overly broad permissions can escalate privileges to access resources beyond intended scope, which leads to unauthorized access to KMS keys, secrets, or other accounts

threats.prerequisites: who compromises ECS task role credentials
threats.threatAction: invoke Connect Health or Bedrock APIs with stolen credentials
threats.threatImpact: unauthorized use of AI services, potential data exfiltration
threats.statement: A Attacker who compromises ECS task role credentials can invoke Connect Health or Bedrock APIs with stolen credentials, which leads to unauthorized use of AI services, potential data exfiltration

threats.threatAction: generate inaccurate clinical notes or hallucinated content
threats.threatImpact: incorrect medical documentation leading to patient harm
threats.statement: A AI model (Bedrock or Connect Health) processing patient encounter data can generate inaccurate clinical notes or hallucinated content, which leads to incorrect medical documentation leading to patient harm

threats.prerequisites: with access to Secrets Manager secret ARN
threats.threatAction: retrieve plaintext database or FHIR API credentials
threats.threatImpact: full database access enabling mass PHI exfiltration
threats.statement: A Attacker or misconfiguration with access to Secrets Manager secret ARN can retrieve plaintext database or FHIR API credentials, which leads to full database access enabling mass PHI exfiltration

threats.threatAction: inject malicious code into application via compromised package
threats.threatImpact: remote code execution in ECS task with access to all PHI
threats.statement: A Supply chain attacker who compromises npm dependency can inject malicious code into application via compromised package, which leads to remote code execution in ECS task with access to all PHI
